risk_assessment.chain_of_thought_reasoning:

2. HYDRAULIC & RIVERINE STAGE: River water level (42.150 m) is safely 3.35 m below Danger Level (45.50 m).
3. TOPOGRAPHIC RUNOFF BEHAVIOR: Catchment terrain has low permeability (Loam, runoff coefficient 0.55, TWI 16.8), accelerating overland surge directly into drainage networks (choke ratio: 8%).
4. SPACEBORNE OBSERVATION: Clear sky condition (20% cloud); optical NDWI (-0.050) and SAR radar (-9.2 dB) corroborate surface water extent.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS: Multi-agent consensus weighted score evaluates to 0.440 with 90.2% sensor certainty. Conclusion: ELEVATED FLOOD WATCH: River Dakshina Kannada River Drainage Basin is rising; drainage networks under pressure.
